basis: Project numerical accuracy targets for uniform small-strain material-card reproduction; not official material calibration or a standard 5% tolerance.
required_kinematics: uniform uniaxial state, free lateral Poisson deformation, actual strain measure and area matching solver formulation, no extra stabilization hidden

mu0_input_reproduction.curve_error_sampling: Compare monotonic loading only at common total-strain values inside card bounds; separate unload/reload path. Interpolate converted-plastic target, inspect residual vs strain.
mu0_input_reproduction.peak_strain_error_bound: one local output strain increment about peak plus literal table numerical precision; report this resolution and do not claim smaller uncertainty
mu0_input_reproduction.unloading_slope_fit: same-sign unloading without new plastic flow/stiffness-recovery reversal; at least 5 usable frames; regress sigma on axial strain and report interval/fit residual
mu0_input_reproduction.legality: nonnegative and nondecreasing plastic conversion at literal nodes; d<1; finite inputs. 1e-12 strain diagnostic floor only covers floating/printed data checks
mu0_input_reproduction.budget_reason: Algebraic target exact for supplied literals; tolerances above permit solver/increment/output precision yet resolve 1%-of-peak tensile residual and meaningful slope changes. Refine increments when exceeded; do not retune card.

mu1e_minus5_branch.classification: If actual-mu branch exceeds reproduction budget, label viscosity/path influenced. It does not alone prove invalid material data or failed calibration. Hold production response-rate applicability until rate/increment diagnosis.
mu1e_minus5_branch.required_record: actual total pseudo-time, strain-rate/amplitude, max actual increment, mu/T and mu relative to damage-transition loading duration
mu1e_minus5_branch.diagnostic_trigger: halve max increment without changing total loading time; if branch difference persists, increase loading duration or reduce mu in a new diagnostic run to separate time integration from regularization. Preserve actual mu baseline.

dense_reference_interpolation.warning: Uniform dense sampling can miss slope corners. Node comparison is primary; interpolation difference estimated by doubling dense sampling belongs to target-processing budget.

outside_table: Do not certify target reproduction beyond last recorded total-strain node or through reversed-sign recovery from this monotonic target alone.
